2. On 2-9-96 the petitioners made an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act being Miscellaneous Case No. 18 of 1996 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Second Court at Noakhali against opposite party No.1 preemption (purchaser) and others for preemption. The application was allowed ex parte on 16-4-98. 

 11. Regarding authorisation, her case is that her father first heard of the case from the daily labours of the preemptors, and then, on 28-9-98 he got the record searched by the clerk of Mr Nurul Huq Advocate and learnt about the case and ex parte order for preemption, and informed her. When she made her husband known over telephone about the same and asked for authorisation, her husband gave her authorisation over telephone to make the application. Thus authorised, she made the application. In her testimony, she has also stated that she got written authorisation. In cross-examination, she has deposed that her husband lives in Abu Dhabi since before her marriage for last 15 years.
